proposal.expected_benefit: This enhancement will improve the system's ability to detect and respond to adversarial strategies in real-time, reducing the risk of consensus failure and ensuring robust system integrity.
proposal.problem: The current strategy lacks explicit real-time monitoring and dynamic threshold adjustments for consensus safety, which could leave gaps in handling adversarial strategies effectively.
proposal.proposed_change: Integrate real-time monitoring mechanisms and dynamic threshold adjustments into the consensus safety strategy to adapt to adversarial behaviors and maintain system integrity during consensus divergence.
proposal.title: Enhance Real-Time Monitoring and Dynamic Threshold Adjustments
verification_tests: Real-time monitoring simulation under adversarial conditions
Dynamic threshold adjustment validation during consensus divergence scenarios
